fee_notes: $45,000 for single Mr. Transmission or Milex Center; $55,000 for Co-Branded Center. Veterans receive $6,750 discount via VetFran. Additional $5,000 Security Deposit and $5,000 Training Fee also due at signing. Area Developer second and subsequent Co-Brand centers reduced to $35,000.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for the right to operate a Mr. Transmission Center or Milex Center is $45,000. The initial franchise fee for the right to operate a Co-Branded Center is $55,000.
